changelog: Source-verified placement: CloudStream's settings landing page is a single scrollable column ending in its build stamp, and plugin rows cannot be registered into it (the screen list is an immutable persistent list with host string resources). The entry therefore overlays the stamp slot, which is the only way to get Extensions -> CSM -> version line.
The entry now reserves exactly the row height measured against the Compose view's own top offset, so the list keeps every previously visible row instead of losing one to a too-tall reservation.
The settings list end is anchored in window coordinates and clamped to the viewport, so the entry cannot slide under the bottom navigation bar.
